name: Peace Making
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively seek and pursue peace by turning away from evil and doing good, as Psalm 34:14 instructs. True peace is rooted in a steadfast trust in God, who grants perfect peace to those whose minds are fixed on Him, as Isaiah 26:3 reveals. Jesus highlights the blessedness of peacemakers, promising they will be recognized as God's children (Matthew 5:9), and offers a peace unlike the world's, which calms troubled hearts and removes fear (John 14:27). This peace-making reflects a Christ-centered life that rejects retaliation (Matthew 5:38) and embraces reconciliation and divine peace.
